newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Belgian minister says no plans to sell gold.
newsitem.headline: Belgian minister says no plans to sell gold.

text.p: Belgium has no plans to sell off more gold reserves as part of efforts to lower its debt ahead of European currency union, Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt said on Saturday.

Maystadt told reporters at the World Economic Forum here that Belgium would be able to lower its debt/GDP ratio without selling gold. "We have no plans to sell more gold," he said when asked whether further reserves would be put on the market.

Belgium's central bank sold a total of 700 tonnes of gold in recent years as it sought to lower its debt and meet strict budget, borrowing and inflation criteria for the single currency launch in 1999 under Economic and Monetary Union (EMU).
